name: @bc/collector
description: Data collector and always-on scanner: record Hypixel's public bazaar and auction data into contribution files; the scanner also pushes them to the GitHub repository (dependency-free single files).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/collect.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/bazaar-calc-collector.mjs && esbuild src/scanner.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' --outfile=dist/bazaar-calc-scanner.mjs && node --check src/server-upload.mjs
scripts.test: node --check src/server-upload.mjs && esbuild src/github.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/test/github.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test test/github.test.mjs
